map.ℹ️ 尼斯分类（Nice Classification）是国际通用的商标注册商品: ℹ️ The Nice Classification is the international standard for classifying goods and services in trademark registration, with 45 classes in all: classes 1-34 for goods and classes 35-45 for services.
map.ℹ️ 本工具提供分类概览，具体商品/服务项请以商标局《类似商品和服务区分表》为准: ℹ️ This tool gives a class overview; for specific items of goods or services, the trademark office's Table of Similar Goods and Services governs.
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供参考，不构成法律建议，具体问题请咨询专业律师。: ⚠️ This tool is reference only and not legal advice; consult a professional lawyer on specific issues.
map.注册前按商品/服务确定所属尼斯分类，避免选错类别。: Before registering, identify the Nice class for the goods or services so that the wrong class is not chosen.
map.通过关键词、类别号检索，查看类别名称与典型商品示例。: Search by keyword or class number to see the class name and typical examples of goods.
map.跨业务线规划多类注册防御。: Plan defensive registration across several classes for multiple business lines.
map.第 9 类「科学仪器」（计算机、软件、电池、眼镜）；第 35 类「广告销售」；第: Class 9 covers scientific instruments such as computers, software, batteries and eyewear; class 35 covers advertising and sales; class 42 covers technology services such as programming, cloud computing and industrial design; class 38 covers telecommunications.
map.输入「App」命中第 9 类（软件）、第 42 类（编程）、第 35 类（广告）: Entering "App" hits class 9 for software, class 42 for programming and class 35 for advertising, among others, and the tool lists the classes and examples to help you choose.
map.一个商标能跨类保护吗？: Can one trademark be protected across classes?
map.商标按类保护，未在册类别不受该商标保护；重要品牌建议多类甚至全类注册防御。: A trademark is protected by class, and classes that are not registered are not protected; important brands should register in several or even all classes as a defence.
map.分类选错有什么后果？: What happens if the wrong class is chosen?
map.选错类别可能导致核准的商品不含实际经营项，被他人在正确类别抢注近似商标，需重新申: The wrong class may mean the approved goods do not cover what is actually sold, and someone else may register a similar mark in the correct class, forcing a fresh application or an opposition.
